extra.split_policy: split by episode generator seed group: train=[0,800), val=[800,1000), test=[1000,1200); source_id = 'ep<index>' (never split by frame); test episodes are generated independently

summary_channels.name: vis_frac
summary_channels.meaning: number of currently observed object tokens / 16

summary_channels.name: any_hidden
summary_channels.meaning: 1.0 if at least one existing object is currently hidden

summary_channels.name: query
summary_channels.meaning: 1.0 on steps flagged as a recall query

summary_channels.name: event_type_norm
summary_channels.meaning: event type / (C_EVENT-1) in [0,1]; 0 when no event

summary_channels.name: event_age_s_60
summary_channels.meaning: seconds since the last event / 60 s (0 if none yet)

summary_channels.name: since_change_s_60
summary_channels.meaning: seconds since any visible token value last changed / 60 s

summary_channels.name: hidden_asked_frac
summary_channels.meaning: number of object-slots that are existing+hidden / 16

summary_channels.name: mean_vis_norm
summary_channels.meaning: mean L2 norm of the currently observed token values

tok.channels_0_15: that object's current 16-dim value (identity dims zeroed when visible-but-not-identifiable)
tok.channel_16: visibility flag: 1.0 iff the object is observed now; when not observed the entire token is 0

labels.lab_state: [T, 256] float32 = 16 slots x 16 state dims; true state scaled by lab_mask-independent knowability (0 where the slot is unused or its value is unknowable)
labels.lab_mask: [T, 16] float32 = 1.0 iff the slot is asked for (knowable but absent from the current observation); all metrics are computed on lab_mask==1
labels.lab_class: [T] int64 = -1 ignore; identity id (vanish_reappear) or event type (event_seq)

channel_layout.identity_code: state dims 0..7: signed one-hot (16 identities); dims 8..15: N(0,1) analogue

extra.notes: base vanish_reappear dataset (train/val/test, split by episode group); eval-only companions: synth_vanish_reappear_shuffled

oracle_reference_definition.perfect: unbounded faithful memory reading only the observation (PerfectMemoryOracle) -> sanity upper bound 1.0
oracle_reference_definition.memoryless: outputs the current observation only (ZeroMemoryOracle) -> memoryless bound
